title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
description: Discover the functional student spaces at the College of the Holy Cross, from late-night study rooms in Dinand Library to the modern gathering spots in the Prior Performing Arts Center.

cards.title: Late Night Study at Dinand
cards.subtitle: Dinand Library
cards.notes: Access the designated 24-hour study space for late-night academic sessions when the main library floors close at midnight.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated 24-hour study area within the main campus library for students.
cards.evidence_claim: Dinand Library offers a 24-hour study space for students, even when main library hours end at midnight.
cards.source_title: Dinand Library | College of the Holy Cross
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours for students with valid ID; main library floors typically close at midnight.

cards.title: Gathering in the Beehive
cards.subtitle: Prior Performing Arts Center
cards.notes: Visit this three-story architectural atrium for informal gathering, studying, and coffee at the O'Connor Family Cafe.
cards.short_summary: A modern, multi-story atrium designed for student collaboration and relaxation.
cards.evidence_claim: The Beehive is a three-story atrium in the Prior Performing Arts Center used for gathering, studying, and rejuvenation.
cards.access_notes: Open during building hours; includes the O'Connor Family Cafe for snacks and beverages.

cards.title: Quiet Study in Rehm
cards.subtitle: Smith Hall
cards.notes: Utilize this elegant space for quiet reflection and study when it is not hosting lectures or McFarland Center events.
cards.short_summary: A quiet, modern library space used for both events and individual student study.
cards.evidence_claim: When not in use for events, Rehm Library provides a quiet space for study and reflection.
cards.source_title: Libraries | College of the Holy Cross
cards.access_notes: Available for study when no scheduled events are taking place.

cards.title: Relaxing on the Hoval
cards.subtitle: Hogan Courtyard
cards.notes: Join students for outdoor gatherings, food truck events, or casual games on this central oval-shaped lawn.
cards.short_summary: The Hogan Courtyard, known as the Hoval, is a popular outdoor social hub.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hogan Courtyard, affectionately known as the Hoval, is a popular spot for outdoor gatherings and campus events.
cards.access_notes: Public outdoor space accessible at all times.

cards.title: Coffee Breaks at Cool Beans
cards.subtitle: Hogan Campus Center, Level 1
cards.notes: Grab a late-night milkshake or morning coffee at this social hub, open until 11 p.m. daily.
cards.short_summary: A central campus coffee shop and social spot located in the Hogan Campus Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Cool Beans is a social hot spot in Hogan Campus Center open until 11 p.m. for coffee and late-night treats.
cards.source_title: Cool Beans | College of the Holy Cross
cards.access_notes: Open Mon-Fri 7:30 AM - 11 PM, Sat-Sun 9 AM - 11 PM.

cards.title: Morning Meetings at Cafe Babel
cards.subtitle: Stein Hall, First Floor
cards.notes: Coordinate group projects or meet with professors at this popular Starbucks-serving cafe in the main academic building.
cards.short_summary: An academic-centered cafe in Stein Hall serving Starbucks products.
cards.evidence_claim: Cafe Babel is located on the first floor of Stein Hall and is a popular spot for meetings and morning coffee.
cards.source_title: Dining | College of the Holy Cross
cards.access_notes: Open during academic hours; typically closes earlier than Hogan dining spots.

cards.title: Social Hub at Crossroads
cards.subtitle: Hogan Campus Center, Ground Floor
cards.notes: Utilize the lounge area and game room for downtime between classes or late-night study breaks.
cards.short_summary: A multi-functional dining and social space on the bottom floor of the campus center.
cards.evidence_claim: The bottom floor of Hogan houses Crossroads, which includes a game room, lounge area, and grill.
cards.access_notes: Open until midnight daily for food and social use.

cards.title: Science Focused Study
cards.subtitle: Swords Hall, First Floor
cards.notes: Find a quiet desk among the science volumes in this library located within the Integrated Science Complex.
cards.short_summary: A specialized library for science disciplines offering quiet study areas.
cards.evidence_claim: The O'Callahan Science Library occupies the first floor of Swords Hall and provides dedicated study space.
cards.source_title: Libraries | College of the Holy Cross
cards.access_notes: Open during standard library hours; check the library website for seasonal changes.

cards.title: Music Library Retreat
cards.subtitle: Fenwick Hall, East End
cards.notes: Study in a unique environment surrounded by music scores and playback equipment in the historic Fenwick Hall.
cards.short_summary: A specialized music library providing a quiet and unique study atmosphere.
cards.evidence_claim: Located in the east end of Fenwick Hall, the Music Library provides print and electronic music-related materials and study space.
cards.source_title: Libraries | College of the Holy Cross
cards.access_notes: Open during academic hours; accessible to all students for study.

cards.title: Solo Practice with a View
cards.subtitle: Prior Performing Arts Center
cards.notes: Reserve one of the four practice rooms, some of which overlook the Beehive atrium, for vocal or instrumental work.
cards.short_summary: Modern practice rooms available for student reservation in the arts center.
cards.evidence_claim: Students are welcome to reserve one of four music practice rooms at The Prior for solo or small group rehearsals.
cards.access_notes: Reservation required via the Ignite platform; priority for music students.
